case.title: Wood build
case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

messages: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

reviewQuestions: Are materials grounded and quantities sufficient?

Does the final result follow from shown operations?

design.purpose: A compact planter for one gardener to grow herbs or flowering plants on a patio, balcony or sunny windowsill, with drainage and room for at least 15 cm of soil.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Mark the base at 40 cm.
Cut a 40 cm base, leaving 79.7 cm offcut.
Place the second board flat for cutting.
Mark lines at 40, 80, 96 and 112 cm.
Cut 40, 40, 16, 16 and 6.8 cm pieces.
Sand cut edges and faces until smooth.
Place the base flat.
Stand the front side on the base front edge.
Stand the back side on the base back edge.
Fit the left end between the sides.
Fit the right end between the sides.
Drill three 8 mm holes through the base.
Drill two pilot holes at the front-left corner.
Drive screws through front into left end.
Drill two pilot holes at the front-right corner.
Drive screws through front into right end.
Drill two pilot holes at the back-left corner.
Drive screws through back into left end.
Drill two pilot holes at the back-right corner.
Drive screws through back into right end.
Drill three pilot holes through the base front edge.
Drive screws up through base into front.
Drill three pilot holes through the base back edge.
Drive screws up through base into back.
Drill two pilot holes through the base left edge.
Drive screws up through base into left end.
Drill two pilot holes through the base right edge.
Drive screws up through base into right end.
